name: Snap Ship Builder (POC)
author: mccorkle
description:
Build a ship with cubes, the put some thrusters on it.  

Right click on each thruster and set a key to activate that thruster (note, don't use wasd, cause those move the camera). 

Now fly your ship!

--- 

During the previous Unity cyber week sale, I purchased a lot of ship "part kits" and a few ship combat and space sim kits.  To bring those together with the Gestalt design, I first must be able to, ingame, snap parts of a kit together and make a functioning ship in Unity physics.  This is where I'll publish and update as I go along with that.  I am following along with quill18creates's tutorial initially, but will apply my own design and purchased art once I get closer to the end of the tutorials.
